source.note: Archive AMIKO_SHD-8140_1.5.43_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-04.

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU M3801 family (chips/m3801.py, chip ID 0x3811 = ALI_S3811, run_dump_shd8140_1543_app_starts.py, run_dump_shd8140_1543_capture_screen.py): the MIPS16e bootloader "M3612 1.0.4" copies itself to 0x81E80000, writes " ON " to the CH455 4-digit panel on GPIO 31 (SCL) / 9 (SDA), unpacks the 12.15 MB maincode(AV) ("0E020A001543") to 0x80000200 and enters it.  The application moves CP0 EBase to 0x80002000, configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2012 tuner at I2C 0x65, updates the CH455 display to " on ", initialises userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC), and renders its 32-bpp ARGB8888 OSD through GeM36F.

desc: Amiko SHD-8140 CX E (System ID 0E020A00) firmware v1.5.43 EMU (2012-07-10) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.
Built on the single-CPU ALi M3612 SoC (silicon ID 0x3811) with an external ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, Airoha AV2012 tuner at 0x65, and a CH455 front-panel display on GPIO 31 / 9.
